name: literally-a-todo-app
description: The harness of the todo app: the house-style tools and the commands that run both projects. The app is frontend/ and backend/, each with its own lockfile.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix backend
scripts.lint: eslint . && npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix backend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check:conventions
scripts.check:fast: npm run check:fast --prefix frontend && npm run check:fast --prefix backend && node scripts/check-fast.mjs
scripts.check:conventions: npm run knip --prefix frontend && npm run knip --prefix backend && depcruise frontend/src backend/src && node vendor/house-style/bin/check-base-ui.mjs --warn-only && node vendor/house-style/bin/check-structure.mjs --warn-only
